George Chandler, Dr.Harold Lee, Arthur Whitehead and Arthur Penstone approach the 20 miles mark in the London - Brighton race of 1952.
Arthur (left) and Denis Brickwood at the South of Thames CCC held at Sevenoaks, 1961.
The photograph shows Arthur (now 77 years) in Finkle Street with his house in the terrace behind.

Left: The caption with this photograph tells us that this is the first London to Brighton run - August 18th 1951. Arthur Whitehead wears 56 with training and racing companion Arthur Penstone wearing 42. We don't know where they finished on this occasion but the following two years also saw Arthur Whitehead taking part in this 51.75 mile race: he ran 6:44:23 for 15th in 1952 and 7:14:58 for 21st in 1953.
